meta.method: Towns retained only where the OCP municipal opt-in model (refreshed 2026-07-09, maine.gov/dafs/ocp/open-data/adult-use/opt-in-communities) records retail authorization. dispensaries_operating = active adult-use Store licenses per the OCP licensee roster of 2026-07-01. Towns without recorded retail authorization — incl. Bar Harbor and Wells, whose voters rejected retail ordinances in 2022 and 2025 — are not opted-in and are not listed; see the corrections log.
